subject: Implementation ops lanes + dependency timetable
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Sherman <lisa@tessera.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Implementation ops lanes + dependency timetable

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a compact Mutual Action Plan focused on delivery cadence, lane ownership, and dependency gating so we can lock dates and minimize surprises during the integration window. Please find the MAP attached (Tessera_MAP_20270120.xlsx).

High-level proposed milestones (compressed view):
- Kickoff workshop: Jan 25, 2027 — Owners: Mina (Redwood PM) / Lisa (Tessera Product) — 90m remote working session
- Sandbox & connectivity: Jan 26 – Feb 4, 2027 — Owner: Ben (Redwood Infra) — network test, VPN/KMS handshakes
- Data ingestion: Feb 8 – Feb 18, 2027 (tentative; legal signoff gating) — Owner: Tessera Data Ops (Lisa) / Redwood SE (Priyom)
- Validation & QA: Feb 21 – Mar 4, 2027 — Owner: Priyom (Redwood SE) / Tessera QA
- Canary (pilot traffic): Mar 7 – Mar 18, 2027 — Owner: Marissa (CSM) — rollback/playbook in place
- Go-live (full production): Mar 22, 2027 — Owner: Marissa / Ben — 72-hour monitored window
- 30-day hypercare & transfer to BAU: Mar 23 – Apr 22, 2027 — Owner: Marissa

Critical dependencies and notes:
- Legal must clear the data processing addendum by Feb 4 to keep the above ingestion window (I listed the DocuSign link in the attachment).
- We will need IAM-level access (service account + IP allowlist) for the sandbox by Jan 28 — Ben, can you confirm expected firewall/CIDR requirements?
- Procurement: SOW signature and invoice details needed before Feb 1. Marissa, assigning action to you to confirm PO path on Tessera side.

Action items for initial confirmation:
1) Lisa: confirm kickoff attendance (Jan 25) and whether legal will need extra time for DPA (yes/no)
2) Tessera Ops: identify the sandbox point-of-contact for network testing
3) Ben/Priyom: confirm sandbox checklist and any additional infra prep

If anything looks off I can update the MAP and re-issue, but I wanted to get a single lane-based view out so we have owners tied to each date.

Attachments referenced: [Attachment: Tessera_MAP_20270120.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: tessera_network_diagram.pdf (pdf)]

Best,
Mina Haddad
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Lisa Sherman <lisa@tessera.health>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sales Ops <sales_ops@tessera.health>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 13:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation ops lanes + dependency timetable

Thanks Mina — this looks great and more actionable than the slide we reviewed. A couple quick items from our side: 

- Legal flagged the DPA timeline — there is a standing review that may push us ~1 week later. I need to confirm with our counsel but please assume ingestion may need to move to the Feb 8 start you proposed (we'll know no later than Jan 27).
- Kickoff: Jan 25 works for the core team 10:00–11:30 PT. I will bring our product lead and data lead.
- Sandbox owner: assigning to Paul Mendes (paul.mendes@tessera.health) — please include him on the sandbox/network test thread.

Two asks: can you add a short acceptance criteria list for the post-validation gate (what exactly constitutes "validation complete") and include the PO/SOW signoff path so our procurement team knows the target date?

I'll confirm legal timing by Jan 27 and loop in Sales Ops for procurement.

—Lisa
Director, Product Operations | Tessera Health

Lisa / Paul —

Thanks for the quick feedback and for identifying Paul as the sandbox POC. I updated the MAP to reflect the potential legal delay and shifted the data ingestion window to Feb 8 – Feb 18 (still contingent on legal confirmation by Jan 27). I attached a concise acceptance criteria section and procurement path in the updated sheet.

Updated milestone snapshot (key changes in bold):
- Kickoff workshop: Jan 25, 2027 — Owners: Mina / Lisa — confirm 10:00–11:30 PT
- Sandbox & connectivity: Jan 26 – Feb 4, 2027 — Owner: Ben — network testing with Paul (Tessera) on Jan 28
- Data ingestion: Feb 8 – Feb 18, 2027 — Owner: Paul (Tessera Data Ops) / Priyom (Redwood SE) — Gated by DPA signed by Feb 4
- Validation & QA (acceptance criteria included): Feb 21 – Mar 4, 2027 — Owner: Priyom / Tessera QA
- Canary: Mar 7 – Mar 18, 2027 — Owner: Marissa — limited traffic, rollback script tested
- Go-live: Mar 22, 2027 — Owner: Marissa / Ben — post-go-live runbook in Drive

Procurement & SOW path: Marissa will send the SOW to Sales Ops (Sales Ops rep on this thread) and Tessera Procurement. Target for SOW signature: Feb 1. If procurement needs an alternate workflow please flag it in your reply.

Ben — can you confirm the sandbox CIDR list you need from Paul and whether we should plan a brief cutover window for port testing on Jan 29?

Marissa — please confirm you'll own the SOW/PO chase and that you have the invoice template for Tessera.

Thanks — I'll re-upload the MAP after your replies.

Mina

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 11:03:21 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation ops lanes + dependency timetable

All — quick confirmation from the CSM/procurement side: we can hit Feb 1 SOW target assuming Sales Ops at Tessera can route PO approvals within two weeks of signature. I'll start the SOW submission today and attach our invoice template to the DocuSign envelope.

Risk callouts (we should track these in the MAP risk register):
- IAM/service account: Tessera must provide a dedicated service account and an allowlist before Jan 28 or sandbox connectivity will slip — Paul, can you confirm when you'll share the service account owner?
- Data schema freeze: if Tessera's data model changes after the sandbox handoff (post-Jan 29), validation will require an additional sprint — recommend locking schema with a one-week review window immediately post-kickoff.
- Monitoring/alerts: Ben, will you own the initial alerting rules for the canary period? We need escalation thresholds and an on-call rotation documented in the runbook.

Acceptance criteria (short version included in the sheet):
1) Successful end-to-end ingest of 1000 sample records with <1% parsing errors
2) Key metrics within expected ranges for latency and throughput in sandbox (detailed thresholds in the MAP)
3) Signed DPA and SOW in place prior to any production traffic

I'll update the MAP with these items and publish a read-only link in Drive. Ping me if you'd like me to own the cutover call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0147
